hypothesis: The fixed 48/24-candle breakout family has positive prospective net expectancy on both BTC-USD and ETH-USD when entry/holding is limited to objectively active weekdays.
provenance: This narrower hypothesis was selected from the post-hoc regime decomposition of EXP-MKT-001 and therefore receives no evidentiary credit until prospective observations exist.
signal: Existing EXP-MKT-001 breakout target AND UTC weekday AND prior completed candle quote-volume or absolute-return activity above its frozen threshold.
timestamp_rule: Every decision must be durably written before its actionable_at timestamp. Missed scheduler intervals are skipped and never backfilled as prospective decisions.

execution.action_latency: at least one future five-minute boundary after observation

evidence_gate: At least 100 eligible prospective observations or 14 calendar days, positive net return on both products, and deterministic reconciliation/restart behavior.
failure_gate: Reject if either product is non-positive at the evidence gate, timestamp integrity fails, state cannot resume, or parameters would need revision.
next_stage_if_supported: A deeper historical level-2/order-book and venue-specific fee-capacity replay; not live trading.
